name: Noir Slit Gown
description: An exquisitely crafted floor-length gown in pure matte crepe. The dramatic side slit and open back make this the definitive statement piece for the modern icon. Fully lined with a delicate gold-tipped zipper closure.

name: Goldmaster Blazer
description: The epitome of power dressing. Our signature tailored blazer features hand-sewn gold crest buttons, a peaked lapel, and a structured silhouette cut from the finest Italian wool-cashmere blend. A LUXE wardrobe essential.

name: Obsidian Chain Bag
description: A structured top-handle bag in full-grain calfskin leather with 24k gold-plated hardware. The signature chain strap offers versatile carry options. Lined in suede with three interior pockets.

name: Aurea Stiletto
description: A masterclass in understated luxury. Full-grain nappa leather upper on a 9cm solid 24k gold-plated architectural heel. Padded leather insole for all-night comfort. Arriving in a LUXE keepsake box.

name: Camel Oversized Coat
description: Crafted from 100% Australian merino wool in a rich camel tone. Double-breasted with a statement belt, this coat transcends seasons. The oversized silhouette drapes beautifully and pairs effortlessly with everything in your wardrobe.

name: Aurore Silk Scarf
description: A 90x90cm hand-rolled silk twill scarf, screen-printed with our signature abstract Aurore motif in gold and midnight navy. Wear it as a headscarf, belt, or bag accent. Presented in a LUXE gift box.

name: Velvet Midi Dress
description: A plush silk-velvet midi dress with a draped cowl neck and fluid A-line silhouette. The bias cut skims the body beautifully. Fully lined in charmeuse. Available in three deep jewel tones for the season.

name: Signature Logo Belt
description: A sleek 3cm wide belt in smooth calfskin leather with our signature LUXE logo buckle in polished gold. The perfect finishing touch for blazers, trousers, and dresses alike.

name: Structured Leather Tote
description: Our everyday icon. A spacious, structured tote in textured calfskin with a magnetic-snap closure and zip inner pocket. The twin carry handles and removable crossbody strap make it the most versatile bag in your collection.

name: Linen Tailored Trousers
description: High-waisted trousers in a refined European linen blend. The straight-leg, wide cut creates a long, lean line. Complete with a single pleat, side pockets and a concealed zip and hook closure. An enduring wardrobe foundation.
